notes.title: CODE: PANDORA 2
notes.content:
[p]CODE: PANDORA 2: Absolute Weapon. Born from ideas and materials of unreleased DLC for Part One, it has grown into a fully standalone game. [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34742761/ea4d45d1d411ebc4b3248c130fefdf9ee71109fe.png"][/img]What to expect:  Driply and Lika return — with more diplomacy, seduction, and tactical episodes.  Non-linear choices: negotiations, intimacy, and Acts of Terror genuinely change relationships and the ending.  A new Absolute Weapon arc blending mysticism with grim science fiction.  A darkwave-style soundtrack, atmospheric CG scenes, and Pandora’s deviant aesthetics.  For fans of “fast +18 routes”:  The erotic ending Matrix of the Absolute Weapon is easy to get — talk to everyone and stay friendly.  X-Zetrix: assemble her once — and the Gallery unlocks all of her scenes (except her ending).  [/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3758430/KOD_PANDORA_2/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p]Light spoilers :)  X-Zetrix modules are on the worlds of Nox, Whisperer, Lady Iris, and Rascal Z — no Acts of Terror required.  Zone 69 artifacts: at Glok (descend to the lowest floor), at Rascal Z (just land and chat with the right people), on the Ghost-5 station, and near Corsair Seraph’s gauntlet.  18+. Adult content only.  
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34742761/38f25cd51b3f085929cf8d10627c951b734799d8.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Iron Disco
notes.content:
A porn parody of the famous action game is now available! Back in the 80s. Destroy the rebels, enjoy HD cutscenes and do not forget to visit the headquarters in the game, there you will find surprises. A gamepad with Xinput (Xbox or Logitech) works best, but the keyboard can be played too. The menu contains settings for controlling gamepads and keyboard.

notes.title: Halloween
notes.content:
In any game, as in life, there is a place for a joke!ːsteamhappyː
Place the file DFL.txt from the game directory DARK FABLE in \ Witch Halloween \ profile and you can play a comic version of the game. You will find the portal in the gallery. It will also be available to all players who will receive three endings (Coven + Exorcism + Blaze), but due to your supporting, I made this little patch. But I recommend getting at least one ending before this. :-)
Thanks again to everyone who supported me!
Thanks Colonel Sanders, MapcukCynepCmap your comments are priceless
P.S
press the bonus button (F by default) to shoot a ghost
